New monster source assets for Toon Tale star expansion.
12 distinct animated base models, 28 gameplay/visual variants.
All selected source packs are CC0-1.0. Quaternius original author page retained as license evidence.
Source mirror and original-source URLs, pinned commits, original SHA-256 and runtime SHA-256 are in PACKAGE.json.
Runtime GLBs retain the original meshes/rigs and six authored clips, with semantic names and unused buffers removed.
Canonical source/package staging: /workspace/toon-artifacts/star-monster-sources.
Custom closed-roster validation/admission is used because game-dev was unavailable; this is not a game-dev CLI receipt.
Engine import, render and animation correctness are independent checks.
